timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹16.51 Cr, net profit ₹10.49 Cr (against a loss of ₹4.29 Cr a year earlier).
Wealth First eliminated its proprietary trading book to nil, launched Lakshya AMC JV (69.7% stake for ₹41 Cr), and reported FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹38.3 Cr.
Wealth First Portfolio Managers Limited’s earnings call recording for Q4 & FY2026 financial performance, signed by Managing Director Ashish Navnitlal Shah, uploaded on June 1, 2026.
Wealth First held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the launch of Lakshya AMC and insurance broking expansion.
Wealth First Portfolio Managers reported Q1FY27 results with revenue down 42.3% YoY to ₹14.32 Cr and PAT down 34.7% to ₹10.42 Cr
Board meeting held on August 28, 2026 approved convening of 24th AGM on September 24, 2026
Wealth First Portfolio Managers Limited’s 24th AGM on September 24, 2026, approved all seven resolutions via e-voting with 100% shareholder support (8,832,345 votes).
Wealth First Portfolio Managers issued a revised intimation correcting the date of its board meeting notice to October 19, 2026.
Wealth First Portfolio Managers entered into a Share Purchase Agreement on October 26, 2026, to acquire 51% of Wealth First Advisors Private Limited for ₹52.10 Cr.
